task.title: Scaffold system component docs from architecture and file-structure ownership
task.summary: Create `system/components` and `system/flows` docs from architecture/file-structure ownership, then shrink oversized system overview docs into linked index pages under the lint threshold.

goal.outcome: System KB details are reorganized into component and flow docs while oversized overview docs become compact index pages under the lint threshold.
acceptance: `system/components/` exists with compact component docs for architecture nodes that map to current source folders or file-structure owner nodes.
Each component doc has frontmatter including component_id, diagram_refs, code_paths or source_roots, owners, and summary.

`system/flows/` exists with focused docs for decision-to-planning, planning-to-implementation, implementation-validation-close, runtime-daemon-dispatch, artifact-claim-wait-wake, resume-context-boundary, and publication-gc or justified first-slice equivalents.
Each flow doc has frontmatter with flow_id, participants/component_ids, diagram_refs, source_refs or code_paths, and summary.
`api.md`, `compilers.md`, `runtime.md`, and `validation-gateway.md` are below the word-count warning threshold and link to relevant component/flow docs.
No large-doc warnings remain for the four target docs; any remaining large-doc warning is explicitly unrelated.
Actors/artifacts without source ownership remain diagram nodes or flow participants, not component docs.
non_goals: Do not create component docs for every graph node if it lacks source/file-structure ownership.
Do not duplicate all top-level doc prose inside component docs.
Do not change runtime, compiler, gateway, or API behavior.
Do not solve unrelated graph warnings outside the large-doc target.
